title: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'type') on write_file/replace tools

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear, actionable bug report describing a specific TypeError ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'type')') on the write_file and replace tools, complete with CLI version and environment details.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix is localized to schema parameter definitions or parameter validation logic in packages/core/src/tools for file modification tools.

summary.problem: The write_file and replace tools fail with a TypeError ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'type')') during tool execution or parameter validation.
summary.root_cause: Tool schema definitions or parameter validation routines access the 'type' attribute on an undefined parameter property definition.
summary.context: Occurs when executing write_file or replace tools with auto-gemini-3 model configuration.

steps: Verify property definitions in parametersJsonSchema for write_file and replace tools in gemini-3.ts to ensure all parameters declare valid types.
Add null/undefined safe checks when accessing parameter property definitions and their 'type' attribute during parameter validation in write-file.ts and edit.ts.
Ensure tool schema resolution and parameter validation handle optional parameter definitions without throwing TypeError.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: write_file and replace tools validate parameters and execute successfully without throwing TypeError on type property access.
verification_steps: Add unit test cases in write-file.test.ts and edit.test.ts validating parameter schema processing.
Execute vitest suite on packages/core/src/tools to confirm all tool tests pass.
